theorems.name: Submission.regcomp_covectorEuclideanNorm_seminorm_retract
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ Continuous (fun α : Covector (Euclid P) n => covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ (∀ α β : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm (α + β) ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α + covectorEuclideanNorm β) ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), covectorEuclideanNorm (t • α) = |t| * covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm α ≤ c * ‖α‖) ∧ ∀ v b : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm b ≤ 1 → covectorEuclideanNorm ((max 1 (covectorEuclideanNorm v))⁻¹ • v - b) ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm (v - b)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
